title: TrackSearch: a late My likes page overwrites Saved playlists
acceptance: Switching TrackSearch from My likes to Saved playlists (or opening a playlist) invalidates any likes request still in flight, so a late likes page cannot replace the playlists view's rows or clear its error, loading or reconnect state.
A test starts a slow likes first page, switches to Saved playlists, resolves the page, and expects the playlists view unchanged.
nextAction: Round 1123b web Lane 1 (Neo), branch fix/rf-241-tracksearch-late-likes: the fetch effect in apps/web/src/components/TrackSearch.tsx bumps reqId and clears searching when Saved playlists opens, with three tests in TrackSearch.test.tsx (playlists list, reconnect after a failed list, a playlist still loading). Restart: check out the branch, run pnpm --filter @ritmofit/web exec vitest run src/components/TrackSearch.test.tsx, then the AGENTS.md gate.
